Quality Profiles

A quality profile is the single most important config decision. Get this right first.

What a quality profile controls

  • Allowed qualities — which resolutions and sources NGMS will accept
  • Quality order — priority when multiple acceptable releases are found simultaneously
  • Upgrade — whether NGMS replaces a grabbed file when a better one appears
  • Upgrade until — the target quality — once reached, no more upgrades
  • Minimum custom format score — optional lower bound on release scoring

Creating a profile

1

Settings → Quality Profiles → Add Profile

Give it a descriptive name like "1080p Bluray" or "Any".

2

Select allowed qualities

Check every quality tier you'll accept. Common choices: Bluray-1080p, WEB-1080p, Bluray-720p, WEB-720p. Order them by preference — drag to reorder.

3

Set "Upgrade Until"

Choose the quality where upgrades stop. If you set Bluray-1080p as the ceiling, NGMS will upgrade from WEB-1080p when a Bluray rip appears, but won't upgrade again after that.

4

Save and assign

The profile is now available when adding or editing any series or movie. You can also bulk-change profiles via the series or movie list view.

Recommended starter profiles

Profile nameAllowedUpgrade untilUse case
Any All qualities Bluray-1080p Grab anything available, upgrade opportunistically
1080p WEB-1080p, Bluray-1080p Bluray-1080p 1080p only, no SD or 720p fallback
4K HDR Remux-2160p, Bluray-2160p, WEB-2160p Remux-2160p 4K only — requires 4K-capable display and storage
SD Only SDTV, DVD DVD Low-bandwidth or legacy content

Custom formats

Custom formats let you score releases beyond resolution — by codec (x265, AV1), audio (DTS-HD, TrueHD Atmos), release group reputation, HDR type (HDR10+, DV), or any regex against the release name.

Each custom format has a score. The total score of all matching formats is compared against the profile's minimum custom format score. Releases that fall below the minimum are rejected.

Custom formats are defined in Settings → Custom Formats and then referenced inside quality profiles.
